name: pending-changes-message-read-error-untested
body: The message's pending-state read-error fallback — refusing with the read error instead of printing a listing — has no direct test, because `ArtifactDb` exposes no fake seam to make those reads fail. Upgrade it if a database trait or seam lands, or when phase 4's `has_pending_state` folds this gate, which is the first caller that can fail closed on the same reads.
